newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica note to analysts on Unisource.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica note to analysts on Unisource.

text.p: Following is a translation from Spanish of the first two paragraphs of a Telefonica statement sent to financial analysts on Friday regarding its position with European consortium Unisource after its deal with British Telecommunications and MCI Communications Corp :

"Telefonica de Espana, BT and MCI will formalise today, April 18, 1997, the constitution of a strategic alliance of international proportions. The aim of the alliance is the maximisation of the complementary global characteristics brought by Telefonica, the main provider of telecoms services in the Spanish speaking market, and by BT and MCI, which are in the process of a merger.

"Telefonica considers that the signing of the agreement does not contravene the commitments derived from its participation in Unisource given the exclusively European character of this alliance. However it is Telefonica's desire, as a consequence of the extraordinary importance of its activities in Latin America, to configure an international alliance of a global character. For this reason, Telefonica has initiated contacts with its partners in Unisource with the aim of reconsidering its situation within the said alliance."
This above paragraph contains the only reference to its deal with Unisource. The statement goes on to provide legal details of its tie-up with MCI and BT.
